answer.renewal: The Customer may extend it once, for a further two years, with at least six months' written notice before the end of the three years.
answer.notice: The Customer may end it with three months' notice if the Supplier fails two food hygiene inspections in 12 months; otherwise only for material breach.
answer.fees: £2.85 per primary meal and £3.40 per secondary meal, invoiced every four weeks and payable within 30 days; fixed for the first year.
